FAQ

Answers to the most common questions about NYC moving, Manhattan movers, Westchester moves, packing services, and labor-only moving help.

How much do NYC movers cost?

Moving prices depend on the apartment size, inventory, building access, distance, packing needs, and crew size. Atlantic Star Relocations offers clear quote options for local NYC, Manhattan, and Westchester moves.

Do you provide Manhattan movers?

Yes. We handle Manhattan apartment moves, office moves, elevator buildings, walk-ups, loading dock scheduling, COI requirements, narrow hallways, and NYC parking logistics.

Do you serve Westchester, New Rochelle, and White Plains?

Yes. We provide moving services across Westchester County, including New Rochelle, White Plains, Yonkers, Scarsdale, Larchmont, and nearby areas.

Do you offer packing services in NYC and Westchester?

Yes. We offer full packing, partial packing, fragile packing, packing-only service, and move-preparation support for apartments, homes, and offices.

Can I request labor-only movers?

Yes. Labor-only moving help is available for loading, unloading, in-home furniture moving, truck loading, storage unit moves, and rearranging furniture.

Do you handle office and commercial moving?

Yes. Atlantic Star Relocations helps businesses with office moves, commercial relocation support, furniture moving, packing, scheduling, and organized moving coordination.

Do movers protect furniture?

Yes. Furniture protection can include moving blankets, shrink wrap, careful handling, disassembly, reassembly, and organized loading based on the move scope.

Can you help with last-minute moves?

Yes, depending on crew availability. For urgent NYC, Manhattan, or Westchester moving requests, contact Atlantic Star Relocations directly for the fastest response.

Do you provide long-distance moving?

Yes. Atlantic Star Relocations provides local and long-distance moving support, including moves from New York to nearby states and interstate destinations.

How far in advance should I book movers?

Booking 1–3 weeks ahead is recommended, especially at the end of the month, during weekends, or during the busy moving season.
